name: bollinger_ema_sar_v1_1_slope_study
purpose: Replace the overly restrictive monotonic EMA20 slope interpretation with controlled alternatives while keeping every other V1 rule unchanged.

fixed_rules.structure: confirmed 2-left/2-right swing; prior bar sweeps structure and signal reclaims
fixed_rules.signal_candle: rocket rejection wick >=70% body OR body engulfing
fixed_rules.signal_shape: LONG higher low vs prior bar; SHORT lower high vs prior bar
fixed_rules.entry: next bar open after fully closed signal candle
fixed_rules.stop: prior bar low for LONG; prior bar high for SHORT
fixed_rules.exit: 40% Bollinger bandwidth target OR close of third entry bar; stop active; stop-first same-bar ambiguity

slope_variants.A_MONOTONIC3: Original V1: EMA20 must rise/fall on each of the last 3 one-bar transitions.
slope_variants.B_NET3: EMA20 now vs EMA20 3 bars ago must be directionally positive/negative; intermediate one-bar wiggles allowed.
slope_variants.C_ATR5: EMA20 net change over 5 bars must be at least 0.05 ATR14 in trade direction.

decision_rule: This is a discovery diagnostic. Do not pick a variant only because it has the highest return. Compare sample size, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction balance, session concentration and stability before any confirmatory test.
